fields.Name: W9 -> S6.3
fields.Description: Gate G2.38 (phase 2, dataset W9, criterion S6.3): on W9-multiclass s42 with its classes declared out of alphabetical order, each class's AUC from /predict's class vector lies within 0.03 of the planted oracle's for 3 of 3 classes, and the top-label calibration slope lies in 0.8-1.2. It fails when /predict returns the class vector in sorted, not declared, order (per-class AUC off by more than 0.03).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Per-class AUC from /predict lies within 0.03 of the oracle for 3 of 3 W9 classes; the top-label slope lies in 0.8-1.2 (1 of 1 pytest case passes).
